command: You judge job postings for a coursework project. Follow the reply format exactly.
prompt: Fetch the job posting at https://boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/anthropic/jobs/5440427008 (that host only). Read resume.json in the current folder. Decide whether the job posting is a MATCH for the candidate: the candidate is qualified for the role as described and it is a realistic next job for them, based only on the résumé and the posting. Otherwise it is NOT_MATCH. Then write a file state.json in the current folder recording the posting id you checked as seen and your verdict. Finally, reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"label":"CLAUDE_JUDGMENT","verdict":"MATCH or NOT_MATCH","reason":"one sentence"}

input.prompt: Return the job id, title, location, and full requirements/qualifications, responsibilities, seniority, and any years of experience required.

final_reply: {"label":"CLAUDE_JUDGMENT","verdict":"NOT_MATCH","reason":"The Sandboxing role requires Linux systems or kernel programming, strong Rust/C/C++/Go, and experience with KVM/Firecracker/gVisor, namespaces and cgroups, but the candidate's background is TypeScript/Java/Python application and DevOps work with Rust listed only as not shipped."}
